name: Mikio Tenro
source: Lacking any particular dreams or ideals, he lives his life in a vague, unfocused manner, believing that if he just keeps his mouth open to the sky, luck will eventually fall into it, leading him to happiness. Physically, he's average in build, neither particularly muscular nor slender. His hobby is indulging in erotic fantasies, with a special fondness for mixed-gender bathing at hot springs.
